name: pacing
description: Use better models and still save weekly usage by delegating easier work to subagents with cheaper models. It spends your weekly plan allowance on purpose: tiers of models, the top tier for the most difficult work, lower tiers for easier work through subagents. A day-by-day budget and the logged trend decide how far down the tiers work goes, so the week never runs out before the reset; better models are used automatically when more usage is left. Tiers, models and efforts are yours to set.
